부동산.ex: 부동산에 가서 집을 몇 군데 봤어요.
부동산.x: I went to a real estate agency and looked at a few places.

주먹.ex: 동생이 화가 나서 주먹을 꽉 쥐었어요.
주먹.x: My younger brother got angry and clenched his fist tightly.
주먹.e: 주먹밥, 'fist rice', is a rice ball shaped by hand.

어학연수.x: In college, I went to Australia for a language study program.
어학연수.t: Pronounced [어항년수]: an ㄴ sound is added, and ㄱ turns into ㅇ before it.

멀쩡하다.m: intact, fine, in perfect condition; sound, sane
멀쩡하다.x: I fell on the street, but luckily my phone is fine.

금융.ex: 그는 대학 졸업 후 금융 회사에 취직했어요.
금융.x: He got a job at a financial company after graduating from college.
금융.e: Literally 'money melting' — money flowing and circulating.

화상.ex: 뜨거운 물에 손을 데어서 화상을 입었어요.
화상.x: I burned my hand with hot water.
화상.e: Literally 'fire wound'; a homonym 화상 means 'video', as in 화상 회의.
화상.t: The everyday native verb is 데다: 손을 데었어요 'I burned my hand'.

신생아.ex: 신생아는 하루에 열여섯 시간 넘게 잔다고 해요.
신생아.x: They say newborns sleep more than sixteen hours a day.

해상도.ex: 해상도가 높은 모니터로 보니까 화면이 아주 선명해요.
해상도.x: Looking at it on a high-resolution monitor, the screen is really sharp.

사막.ex: 사막에서는 낮과 밤의 기온 차이가 커요.
사막.x: In the desert, the temperature difference between day and night is large.

합법적.x: They earned money by legal means.

조항.x: Read the clauses of the contract carefully.

남용하다.m: to abuse, to misuse, to overuse
남용하다.ex: 항생제를 남용하면 건강에 해로울 수 있어요.
남용하다.x: Overusing antibiotics can be harmful to your health.
남용하다.e: Literally 'overflowing use': using beyond the proper limit.

음방.ex: 이번 주 음방에서 신곡 무대를 처음 공개해요.
음방.x: They're revealing the new song's stage for the first time on a music show this week.
음방.e: Short for 음악 방송 'music broadcast', taking the first syllable of each word.
음방.t: Casual fan word. Weekly music shows feature live K-pop stages and give a weekly 1위 (No. 1) trophy.

사색.x: I was lost in thought as I walked along a quiet forest path.
사색.t: Fixed phrase: 사색에 잠기다 'be lost in thought'.

소속감.x: Joining a club gave me a sense of belonging.
소속감.e: Literally 'the feeling of where you belong'.

골동품.e: The characters (bone + supervise) don't describe the meaning; learn it as one word plus -품 'article'.
골동품.t: Pronounced [골똥품] — tensing after the ㄹ batchim.

굳어지다.m: to become hard, to stiffen; to become fixed, to become entrenched
굳어지다.x: Once a habit becomes fixed, it's hard to change.

더욱이.forms: A. 더욱이 B. — adds a stronger point (often with 까지/도)
더욱이.ex: 오늘은 바쁜데 더욱이 손님까지 와서 정신이 없어요.
더욱이.x: I'm busy today, and on top of that guests came over, so it's chaos.
더욱이.e: Built from 더욱 'even more' plus the adverb ending -이.
더욱이.t: Pronounced [더우기]; often paired with 까지 or 도 to stress the added point.

재량.ex: 휴가 날짜는 팀장의 재량에 따라 정할 수 있어요.
재량.x: Vacation dates can be set at the team leader's discretion.

연역.ex: 이 결론은 몇 가지 전제에서 연역을 통해 얻은 거예요.
연역.x: This conclusion was reached through deduction from a few premises.
연역.e: Literally 'drawing out and unraveling': pulling conclusions out of premises.
연역.t: Pronounced [여녁]: the ㄴ carries over into the next vowel.

기획전.ex: 이번 기획전은 한국 근대 미술을 주제로 합니다.
기획전.x: This special exhibition focuses on modern Korean art.
기획전.e: Literally 'planned exhibition' — organized around a theme.

무형문화재.m: intangible cultural heritage, intangible cultural property
무형문화재.x: Pansori is designated and protected as a National Intangible Cultural Property.
무형문화재.e: Literally 'cultural asset without form', such as music, dance and crafts.
무형문화재.t: Since 2024 the official term is 무형유산, but 무형문화재 is still widely used.

순망치한.m: interdependence; when one falls, the other suffers
순망치한.ex: 두 나라는 순망치한의 관계라서 서로 도와야 합니다.
순망치한.x: The two countries depend on each other, so they must help each other.
순망치한.e: Literally 'without lips, the teeth get cold'.
순망치한.t: Often used for neighboring countries or partner businesses: 순망치한의 관계.

체득하다.m: to learn through experience, to master by doing
체득하다.x: He mastered the skills by working on site.
체득하다.e: Literally 'gain with the body' — learning by doing.

곰삭다.m: to ferment fully, to mellow with age; (of cloth) to wear thin
곰삭다.ex: 잘 곰삭은 젓갈은 깊은 맛이 나요.
곰삭다.x: Well-fermented salted seafood has a deep flavor.
곰삭다.e: Built on 삭다 'to ferment, to break down' — think slow, deep aging, like jeotgal or old memories.
곰삭다.t: Pronounced [곰삭따]; also figurative: 곰삭은 정 'affection deepened over years'.

태동.m: stirrings, early beginnings (of a movement); fetal movement
태동.x: In the 1920s, a new literary movement began to stir.
태동.e: Literally 'movement in the womb': the first signs of something about to be born.

열 번 찍어 안 넘어가는 나무 없다.de: 열 번 찍어 안 넘어가는 나무 없다
열 번 찍어 안 넘어가는 나무 없다.rom: yeol beon jjigeo an neomeoganeun namu eopda
열 번 찍어 안 넘어가는 나무 없다.pr: 열 번 찌거 안 너머가는 나무 업따
열 번 찍어 안 넘어가는 나무 없다.forms: 열 번 찍어 안 넘어가는 나무 없다고 · 열 번 찍어 안 넘어가는 나무 없다잖아요
열 번 찍어 안 넘어가는 나무 없다.m: persistence pays off; keep trying and you'll win anyone over (lit. there's no tree that won't fall after ten chops)
열 번 찍어 안 넘어가는 나무 없다.ex: 열 번 찍어 안 넘어가는 나무 없다고, 계속 고백했더니 결국 사귀게 됐어요.
열 번 찍어 안 넘어가는 나무 없다.x: Persistence pays off: I kept confessing my feelings, and in the end we started dating.
열 번 찍어 안 넘어가는 나무 없다.e: 찍다 here means 'to chop with an axe': strike any tree ten times and it will fall.
열 번 찍어 안 넘어가는 나무 없다.t: Often used, half-jokingly, about persistently asking someone out or trying to persuade someone.
nb: 서당 개 삼 년이면 풍월을 읊는다
낮말은 새가 듣고 밤말은 쥐가 듣는다
말 한마디로 천 냥 빚을 갚는다

원님 덕에 나팔 분다.forms: 원님 덕에 나팔 분다더니 · 원님 덕에 나팔 부는 격이에요
원님 덕에 나팔 분다.m: to enjoy perks thanks to someone else's position, to ride on someone's coattails (lit. to blow the trumpet thanks to the magistrate)
원님 덕에 나팔 분다.ex: 원님 덕에 나팔 분다더니, 언니 덕분에 나도 공연을 맨 앞자리에서 봤어요.
원님 덕에 나팔 분다.x: They say you blow the trumpet thanks to the magistrate: thanks to my sister, I got to see the show from the front row too.
원님 덕에 나팔 분다.e: Literally 'thanks to the magistrate, one blows the trumpet'. When a Joseon county magistrate (원님) traveled, trumpeters marched ahead of him and shared in the grand procession and hospitality, though the honor was really his.
원님 덕에 나팔 분다.t: Close to 'riding on someone's coattails', but usually light and often self-mocking about an unexpected perk. For abusing borrowed power, use 호가호위 instead.
rel: borrowing another's power to throw one's weight around
